notes: Nine localized object-state episodes are supported. The two independently movable pantry cabinet doors are reported separately as required, although their closing actions occur partly outside the sampled view and therefore have lower confidence. Ordinary passage through the living-room/bedroom doorway was not counted because a complete intentional on/off episode was not clearly supported.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment kitchen, living/dining area, utility closets, laundry alcove, and bedroom. The user successively opens and closes appliance doors, a drawer, cabinet doors, and closet doors.
